whatsNew.ko:
새 캐릭터 카피바라가 왔어요.
• 옷 15단계와 우산, 잠금화면 그림까지 카피바라 것으로 새로 그렸어요.
• 출시 기념 이벤트: 기간 안에 앱을 열고 받기를 누르면 카피바라를 선물로 드려요. Plus가 없어도 계속 쓸 수 있어요.
• iCloud에 보관을 켜 두면 받은 캐릭터도 날씨 달력과 함께 남아요. 폰을 바꾸거나 다시 설치해도 그대로예요.
• 처음 시작할 때 iCloud에 보관할지 고를 수 있어요.
whatsNew.en-US:
Meet the new character: the Capybara.
• All 15 outfits, the umbrella and the Lock Screen pictures, drawn just for the Capybara.
• Launch gift: open the app during the event and tap Get to receive the Capybara. It stays yours, even without Plus.
• With Keep in iCloud on, gifted characters stay with your weather calendar on a new iPhone or after reinstalling.
• Choose whether to keep things in iCloud when you first open the app.
whatsNew.ja:
新しいキャラクター、カピバラが登場しました。
• 15段階の服装、傘、ロック画面のイラストまで、カピバラ用に描き下ろしました。
• リリース記念イベント：期間中にアプリを開いて「受け取る」を押すと、カピバラをプレゼント。Plusがなくてもずっと使えます。
• 「iCloudに保存」をオンにすると、もらったキャラクターも天気カレンダーと一緒に残ります。機種変更や再インストールをしてもそのままです。
• 最初にアプリを開いたときに、iCloudに保存するかどうかを選べます。

• 首次打开应用时，可以选择是否保存到 iCloud。

Новый персонаж — Капибара.

reviewNotes:
Purrcast (Korean name: 그르릉날씨) is a weather app: a pixel character changes clothes by the feels-like temperature and holds an umbrella when it rains. The app is in 12 languages.

- No login. Location is used only to get the forecast for the current place (rounded to ~1 km); the user can turn it off and pick places instead. Widgets may use the location too, to show the weather where the phone is.
- Weather comes from our own server: KMA 기상청 for Korea (with Apple Weather for the later hours), Apple Weather (WeatherKit) elsewhere, MET Norway for the forecast comparison; air quality from AirKorea (Korea) and OpenWeather (elsewhere). Credited in Settings > Data sources.
- Widgets: Home Screen (small, medium, hourly), Lock Screen (circular and rectangular) and the line above the Lock Screen clock (the dressed character with the temperature, the place, rain, UV, sunrise/sunset, wind, air, or all in one line).
- Weather calendar (Plus): each day used with Plus, the day's weather and outfit is saved on the device, at the place where the phone was at midnight; with Keep in iCloud on (asked once during onboarding, changeable in Settings > Weather calendar) also in the user's own private iCloud database (CloudKit), which we cannot read. Nothing is filled in from the server. A monthly report notification comes on the 1st.
- New in 1.2.1, launch gift event: our server switches the event on (it is on during review). A banner under the weather on the home screen offers the new Capybara character for free; tap Get and it is selected and stays available without Plus. With Keep in iCloud on, the gift is also kept in the user's private iCloud database so it comes back after a reinstall. Nothing is bought, and no account, rating or review is asked for.
- For the rain alert on the Lock Screen / Dynamic Island, the app registers a random device ID, the place rounded to ~1 km and an ActivityKit push token with our server; it is deleted after 45 days without a check-in.
- Purrcast Plus (auto-renewable subscription, yearly / monthly, free trial for new subscribers) unlocks: forecast refresh with every new run, the rain-soon card (next 6 hours; minute-by-minute where Apple Weather provides it, e.g. in the US), short Live Activity alerts (rain or snow an hour before and as it starts, official warnings, poor air, temperature changes), the air quality map with hourly fine dust readings and the Lock Screen air widget, the weather calendar and monthly report, the Apple Watch app and complications, unlimited places, and three more characters (Abyssinian, British Shorthair, Capybara). Purchase and restore are on the Plus screen (gear icon > Purrcast Plus, or the character button).
- To test Plus, please use a Sandbox account. The Apple Watch app shows its content only with Plus and gets its data from the iPhone app.
